title: 5G Technology Is Secretly Controlling Our Brains

claims.text: 5G radiation causes DNA damage and increases cancer risk.
claims.explanation: The World Health Organization states that no adverse health effects have been proven from 5G exposure within international guidelines.

claims.text: 5G technology was created to control the population through electromagnetic waves.
claims.explanation: Conspiracy theory with zero scientific evidence. 5G is a telecommunications standard, not a mind control device.

claims.text: 5G signals are non-ionizing radiation, similar to visible light.
claims.explanation: True. 5G uses non-ionizing radio frequencies similar to Wi-Fi and visible light.

claims.text: International guidelines limit 5G exposure to safe levels.
claims.explanation: True. ICANIRP and WHO have established guidelines that countries follow to ensure safe 5G deployment.

trust_score_description: Low - Only 2 out of 4 claims are factually accurate
